children: Avation PLC (LSE: AVAP, "Avation" or "the Company"), the commercial passenger aircraft leasing company will publish results for the financial year ended 30 June 2026 at 7:00 am BST (UK) on Wednesday, 30 September 2026.

The Company has scheduled an investor update call on Wednesday, 30 September 2026 at 8:00 am EST (USA), 1:00 pm BST (UK), 8:00 pm SGT (Singapore) to discuss the results. The presentation is open to all existing and potential shareholders and stakeholders.

The update call will be hosted on the LSEG SparkLive platform. Investors who would like to join the update call should register with LSEG SparkLive before the meeting by following the link: https://sparklive.lseg.com

Investors who already follow Avation PLC on LSEG website will also be invited to the update call. Questions can be submitted in advance via the LSEG SparkLive platform until 9am the day before the call or during the live presentation.
A replay of the update call will be made available on the LSEG webpage and on the Avation PLC website.
Avation PLC - Jeff Chatfield, Executive Chairman

Avation welcomes shareholder questions and comments and advises the email address is: investor@avation.net and the Company provides an investor Q & A during the update call associated with the release results. The head office telephone number is +65 6252 2077.

Notes to Editors:  Avation PLC is an aircraft leasing company, headquartered in Singapore, owning and managing a fleet of commercial passenger aircraft which it leases to airlines around the world. More information on Avation is available at www.avation.net.
